findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe deserialization
 * @description Deserializing untrusted data using pickle can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/aiohttp-unsafe-deserialization
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("marshal").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("shelve").getMember("open").getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe deserialization operation that could execute arbitrary code."
findings.hypothesis: Check for unsafe deserialization using pickle or other unsafe methods that could lead to arbitrary code execution

message.text: Potentially unsafe deserialization operation that could execute arbitrary code.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Use of weak cryptographic algorithms
 * @description Using weak or insecure cryptographic algorithms can compromise security
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/aiohttp-weak-crypto
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-327
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("hashlib").getMember(["md5", "sha1"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("random").getMember(["random", "randint", "choice", "randrange"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Use of weak cryptographic algorithm or insecure random number generator."
findings.hypothesis: Checking for use of weak cryptographic algorithms (MD5, SHA1) or insecure random number generators that could compromise security

message.text: Use of weak cryptographic algorithm or insecure random number generator.
Use of weak cryptographic algorithm or insecure random number generator.
